description.text:
30th Anniversary Chinese Promos holds the Simplified Chinese promos made for Pokémon's 30th anniversary in 2026, numbered NNN/30th-P with the 30th anniversary Pikachu mark and regulation mark J. Its first 27 cards are the First Partner special illustration holos (最初的伙伴特别插画闪卡), sold one at random in the 30th Celebration First Partner Special Illustration Holo Sets with an acrylic magnetic display frame and a 5-card booster: Vol. 1 on 20 March 2026 with the first partners of Kanto, Sinnoh and Alola, Vol. 2 on 19 June with those of Johto, Unova and Galar, and Vol. 3 on 7 August with those of Hoenn, Kalos and Paldea. Each card is full of places and things from its region's games, and the three cards of a region line up into one long picture.

With the 30th Celebration booster on 16 September 2026 came a display box with holo Espeon ex and Umbreon ex, by day and by night, watching the celebrations from a balcony, and card display sets with a new Greninja ex or Sylveon ex. Alolan Exeggutor is the prize of the Alola Celebration (阿罗拉欢庆赛), three-player team events held from 30 September to 30 November 2026: after each round one lucky team is drawn and each member gets one, up to three teams an event. Our list numbers the cards up to 036.

Side by side, this card and the Sprigatito and Fuecoco of Vol. 3 make one long picture of Paldea, full of places and things from its games.

description.text: One of the two holo cards in the 30th Celebration Collection Display Box Espeon ex & Umbreon ex (30周年庆典 收藏展示礼盒 太阳伊布ex&月亮伊布ex), on sale in mainland China from 16 September 2026. It shows Espeon by day, sitting on a balcony and looking out at a celebration in the distance; the box's Umbreon ex shows Umbreon there by night. The box also held a two-card display frame, a day and a night celebration fridge magnet and fifteen 30th Celebration boosters.

description.text: The prize of the day mission of the Day and Night Celebration (日夜庆典), run through the official Pokémon card member mini program: take part in five designated card gym events between 8:00 and 17:00 in October 2026, five more in November, and events run by three different organizers. Players who finished got a voucher for one card, sent by post, to redeem by 31 December 2026 while the 75,000 made lasted; the night mission's prize was Zeraora.

After each round one team was drawn by lot and each of its three players got this card, up to three teams an event and each team once.
